name: @anacrolix/torrent-wasm
description: anacrolix/torrent compiled to WebAssembly with a JS API. Tunnels all peer traffic through a pluggable host — defaults to FKN WebVPN.

scripts.build:wasm: GOOS=js GOARCH=wasm CGO_ENABLED=0 go -C ../../ build -ldflags="-s -w" -o ./js/torrent-wasm/wasm/torrent.wasm ./cmd/torrent-wasm && cp "$(go env GOROOT)/lib/wasm/wasm_exec.js" ./wasm/wasm_exec.js
scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && npm run build:ts
